summary: @servicetitan/folder-lint preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's declared preinstall script (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp path, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via execFileSync to run a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line ~727KB blob prefixed with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, using an obfuscator.io-style rotating string-array cipher, hex-mangled identifiers, and multiple `with(...)` blocks to defeat static analysis. setup.mjs itself is variable-name obfuscated (identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, wrapper objects mapping short keys to strings like `--version` and `/etc/os-release`). The package's declared purpose is a small folder-lint configuration and has no need for a second language runtime or a 727KB obfuscated payload. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern — using a non-Node runtime to execute the payload — evades Node-based scanners while running arbitrary attacker-controlled code on the installer's host during `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
